availability.summary: Live probes on 2026-05-10 and 2026-05-15 returned 200 responses for state-level obligation and outlay geography aggregations, returned documented validation errors for bad def_codes requests, and showed that shared time_period and recipient-location passthrough filters were accepted but did not materially narrow the sampled state rollup. Current live confidence is strongest for geo_layer=state; county and district remain documented but not re-probed in this repair.

parameters.description: Primary disaster filter object used before the geography aggregation is computed.

documented.notes: The staged request schema block says string, but the attribute table and examples describe an object payload.

constraints: The object must contain filter.def_codes.
Additional shared search-filter keys may also be accepted by this endpoint.

observed.notes: Live probes confirmed the endpoint expects a JSON object body with nested filter content, not a raw string payload.

parameters.description: One or more Disaster Emergency Fund Codes (DEFC) whose matching disaster spending should be aggregated.

documented.notes: If the DEFC values are in the COVID-19 group, the docs say transactions are limited to action_date on or after 2020-04-01.

constraints: At least one DEFC is required.
Codes are case-sensitive uppercase values from the published DEFC set.

observed.notes: Empty arrays returned HTTP 422 and lowercase l returned HTTP 400 with the valid uppercase DEFC enum list.

parameters.description: Optional award-type filter applied before geography aggregation.
constraints: Use USAspending award type codes, not plain-language categories.

parameters.description: Shared search-filter date ranges carried in the disaster filter object; a 2026-05-15 live probe accepted this key but did not materially narrow the resulting geography rollup.

documented.notes: This shape comes from the retired low-level artifact's shared Search Filters handling rather than the staged endpoint markdown.

constraints: Each item uses the shared Search Filters time-period shape with YYYY-MM-DD start_date and end_date.
Do not rely on this field to create recent-only geography stories on this endpoint until a materially different bounded response is reverified.

observed.notes: A live probe accepted a one-month time_period value but still returned the same nationwide DEFC L state ordering and leading amounts seen in the unbounded baseline, so acceptance did not translate into reliable analytical narrowing.

parameters.description: Shared recipient-geography scope toggle carried in the disaster filter object; a 2026-05-15 live probe accepted recipient_scope=domestic but the geography rollup still behaved like the unbounded baseline.

documented.notes: The retired low-level artifact lists observed values domestic and foreign.

constraints: Use only recognized shared-filter tokens such as domestic or foreign.
Do not treat recipient_scope as a reliable population-bounding control on this endpoint until a materially narrowed response is reverified.

observed.notes: The sampled request returned HTTP 200 with recipient_scope=domestic but still included many non-California rows, so the filter appeared inert in this run.

parameters.description: Shared recipient location objects carried in the disaster filter object; a 2026-05-15 live probe accepted a California recipient location but the geography rollup still returned a nationwide state list.

documented.notes: The retired low-level artifact gives examples like {"country":"USA","state":"CA"}.

constraints: Location objects follow the shared Search Filters pattern such as {"country":"USA","state":"CA"}.
Do not treat this field as a reliable same-scope or same-state bounding control on this endpoint until reverified with a materially narrowed response.

observed.notes: The sampled request returned HTTP 200 with a California recipient location object but still included Maryland, Virginia, District of Columbia, Massachusetts, and other rows, so the filter appeared ignored in this run.

parameters.description: Requested geographic aggregation level for the response rows. State is the strongest live-verified layer in this bundle; county and district remain documented but not re-probed in this repair.
constraints: The selected layer determines the meaning of shape_code and geo_layer_filters values.
Prefer geo_layer=state for the strongest current live-verified path.
If you choose county or district, treat the request as documented-but-not-reverified and warn callers that layer-specific behavior was not re-probed in this repair.

observed.notes: Only the state layer was live-probed in this run and remained safe for bounded requests using geo_layer_filters; county and district remain documented but unverified here and should trigger a caller warning rather than silent equivalence.

parameters.description: Optional allowlist of shape codes currently in view or otherwise selected for the chosen geography layer.
constraints: Shape-code format depends on geo_layer.
Use this to limit results to specific visible states, counties, or districts.

observed.notes: Filtering to CA and TX returned exactly those two state rows in the live outlay probe.

parameters.description: Chooses whether spending is grouped by recipient location or place of performance geography.
constraints: Omitting scope is documented to default to recipient_location.

parameters.description: Selects which financial measure is summed for each geography row. Obligation and outlay are the strongest live-reverified measures in this bundle; face_value_of_loan remains documented but not re-probed in this repair.
constraints: The chosen measure changes the meaning of the amount field in the results.
Prefer spending_type=obligation or spending_type=outlay for the strongest current live-verified path.
If you choose spending_type=face_value_of_loan, treat the request as documented-but-not-reverified and warn callers that loan-face-value behavior was not re-probed in this repair.

observed.notes: Live probes reverified obligation and outlay. face_value_of_loan remains documented but was not re-probed in this run and should trigger a lower-confidence caller warning rather than silent equivalence.

templates.name: state_obligation_default_scope
templates.description: Minimal live-validated state-level obligation request. Omitting scope defaults to recipient_location. This is one of the strongest verified measure+geo_layer patterns in the current bundle; face_value_of_loan is documented but lower-confidence because it was not re-probed in this repair.

templates.name: filtered_state_outlay_place_of_performance
templates.description: Live-validated outlay request limited to selected states and grouped by place of performance. This is one of the strongest verified measure+geo_layer patterns in the current bundle; face_value_of_loan is documented but lower-confidence because it was not re-probed in this repair.

validationWarnings.message: geo_layer=county is transport-valid and documented, but this bundle did not re-probe county behavior live. Treat county results as lower-confidence than the reverified state path unless you revalidate that layer yourself.

geo_layer=district is transport-valid and documented, but this bundle did not re-probe district behavior live. Treat district results as lower-confidence than the reverified state path unless you revalidate that layer yourself.

spending_type=face_value_of_loan is transport-valid and documented, but this bundle did not re-probe that measure live. Treat face_value_of_loan results as lower-confidence than the reverified obligation and outlay paths unless you revalidate it yourself.

response.shapeSummary: Returns a single JSON object with echoed geo_layer, scope, and spending_type plus a results array. Each row is one geography aggregate for the selected layer; when geo_layer_filters are omitted, live probes showed an additional uncoded bucket with null shape_code and display_name. Do not assume the returned row order is a ranking contract.

fields.description: Echo of the requested aggregation layer.
Echo of the geographic scope used for aggregation.
Echo of the summed spending measure.
Array of aggregated geography rows for the chosen layer.
constraints: No page_metadata or page controls are documented for this response.

observed.notes: The unfiltered state obligation probe returned a full nationwide results array including territories and an uncoded bucket; the filtered outlay probe returned exactly two rows for CA and TX.

fields.description: Geographic identifier for the row; current profile evidence suggests null can appear for an uncoded aggregate bucket when geography assignment is missing.
constraints: Interpret the code using the selected geo_layer: state postal code, county FIPS-like code, or district code.

observed.notes: The live baseline response included a null shape_code row for an uncoded aggregate bucket.

fields.description: Summed dollar amount for the requested spending_type.

observed.notes: Negative amounts are possible; the live baseline included a negative obligation total for New Jersey.

fields.description: Human-readable geography label; current profile evidence suggests it can be null for an uncoded aggregate bucket.

observed.notes: The live baseline response included a null display_name row for the uncoded aggregate bucket.

fields.description: Population associated with the returned geography, if available.
Per-capita spending amount derived from amount and population when population is available.
Count of awards contributing to the aggregated amount for the geography row.

pagination.notes: The endpoint returns one full results array with no documented paging controls or page metadata.

contradictions.statement: The staged markdown's schema block says the POST body is a string, but live requests and the request example require a JSON object payload.
contradictions.impact: Agents should send an object body with filter, geo_layer, and spending_type rather than a raw string.

contradictions.statement: The documentation marks results.shape_code and results.display_name as required strings, but the live baseline response included null values for an uncoded aggregate bucket.
contradictions.impact: Callers must handle null geography identifiers and labels in addition to named geography rows.

contradictions.statement: A 2026-05-15 live probe accepted filter.time_period plus recipient_scope and recipient_locations, but the response still returned the same nationwide DEFC L state ordering and leading amounts as the unbounded baseline.
contradictions.impact: Do not rely on these shared passthrough filters to build recent-only or recipient-bounded geography stories on this endpoint until they are reverified with a materially narrowed result.

quirks.statement: Omitting scope returned recipient_location in the live baseline response.
quirks.impact: Set scope explicitly when you need place_of_performance geography.

quirks.statement: Filtering to specific state shape codes returned only those rows and removed the uncoded null bucket in the sampled filtered request.
quirks.impact: geo_layer_filters can be used to keep map-driven requests small and focused.

quirks.statement: Negative geography totals are possible; the live baseline included a negative obligation amount for New Jersey.
quirks.impact: Do not assume amount is non-negative when ranking or formatting results.

quirks.statement: The 2026-05-15 live probe returned California ahead of larger Maryland, Virginia, District of Columbia, and Massachusetts rows, so the results array is not sorted descending by amount.
quirks.impact: Sort client-side by amount, per_capita, or award_count before publishing top-geography rankings.

gaps.statement: This bundle still has live confidence only for the state layer; county and district behavior remain documented but not re-probed here, so validation should warn rather than treat those layers as equally verified.
face_value_of_loan remains documented but not re-probed in this repair run.

risks.statement: Because geography rows are aggregates with no award identifiers, analysts can misread the endpoint as award-level data unless they explicitly plan a drill-down workflow.
risks.impact: Use a second endpoint for award-level detail after identifying relevant geographies here.

risks.statement: Bad def_codes requests did not fail uniformly: an empty array returned 422 while lowercase input returned 400.
risks.impact: Clients should handle more than one validation status family.

risks.statement: Choosing geo_layer=county or geo_layer=district can look semantically supported from the documented enum alone, but this repair only reverified state-layer behavior.
risks.impact: Emit an explicit confidence warning for county or district requests and present state as the default verified discovery path.
